title: CVE-2026-41037 — Missing Rate Limiting in Quantum Networks QNOS
excerpt: Brute-forced the admin panel of a QN-I-470 router with 268 attempts — zero rate limiting, zero lockout. Full administrative compromise via CWE-307.

title: CVE-2026-30081 — Cleartext Transmission in Quantum Networks Routers
excerpt: Admin credentials transmitted in plaintext over HTTP on the QN-I-470 router. Intercepted via packet capture on the same network segment. CWE-319.
